symptom: MiniSat's DIMACS parser stores variable indices in a signed int. A literal of 2147483648 (INT_MAX+1) wraps to a negative variable id, and the subsequent value() lookup in SimpSolver::addClause_ reads out of bounds of the assignment vector (heap-buffer-overflow, CWE-190/CWE-125). Built with AddressSanitizer so the read aborts deterministically.
